description: Atomically edit an entity or non-entity object in memory. Read cad.describe_type for writable names and value types. Non-entity edits currently require AC1032 and byte-exact verification of the object. Supports layer settings, text styles/fonts, simple linetype dashes, dimension styles, layout settings and validated dictionary entries. All hosted stored drawings, including uploads, auto-save before reporting success. Local sources use cad.save_as to create a verified new file. Complex linetypes, ownership changes and dictionary graph rewiring are refused.

properties.description: Writable field names to typed values. References are hex strings; colors are {method,index,rgb}; simple dashes accept lengths or returned dash objects; entries are [{name,handle}].

name: cad.set_object_properties
